pages.text: While basic axes can be used for combat and are rather effective against shields, Heavy Axes offer even more specialization towards fighting, at the cost of the normal utilites and axe would offer. They are more unwieldy but can hit harder in return. A Heavy Axe can be crafted using Gluttony Scales, a bit of wood, Crystallized Bonds and a Concentration Core.
While decent as is, it's possible to unlock more usability by awakening it's will using the remnants of a divine being.

Using a Blood Feather and a bit of Organic Matter, the Crescent Disaster can be awakened. With the cooperation of the divine will within, the user can throw the axe with ease despite its weight. Enchanting it with Loyalty will let the thrown axe return.

pages.title: Addendum
pages.text: I may have been exposed to the Risus too much lately. Whenever I wield my crescent, a sense of mild anxiety and paranoia takes a hold. Sometimes it feels like the axe moves a little without my input. I swear, I've heard whispers from it before. And I know that a Concentration Core holds a form of primitive will once brought to life, even when embedded in weaponry. Yet, no other willful weapon has made me feel so... afraid.
